newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises Tues peak firm prices by $1.50/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises Tues peak firm prices by $1.50/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer 200 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Tuesday, but raised prices by $1.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Monday.
BPA offered Tuesday firm power during peak demand hours at $14.00 per MWh in the Northwest and at $15.00 at the California Oregon Border (COB).
Unlimited light-load firm power was unchanged for Tuesday at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
But BPA dropped prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100 to 0500 and 2400 PDT on Tuesday to $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB, compared with $9.00 for all deliveries on Monday.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0600, 0700 and 2300 was unchanged at $10.00.
